reviewer_role: independent core regression author; did not implement product changes
checks: Declarations appends the immutable empty tuple default after all seven previous fields. Previous positional arguments and identity remain intact.
The predicate uses only captured readable nodes and typed include events with non-None normalized targets absent from the final node dictionary.
Assignment occurs after every discovered root expansion. The subsequent closure traversal reads nodes and writes closure/diagnostic results only; it never creates additional nodes.
The added expression deduplicates and sorts paths. It does not infer from closure completeness, exactness, diagnostics or hypothetical file contents.
No depth budget, scanner/read/existence/size call, candidate check, root, event, supported syntax or declaration extraction was added. Current traversal and read boundaries remain identical.

Active-stack and visited early returns already imply a captured node; within-budget excluded and failed-read targets also receive nodes. Final absence therefore identifies the existing depth cutoff under the retained traversal.

Existing declarations, diagnostics, project boundaries, body issues, lock inventories, closure qualification and ownership functions are unchanged. Core tests compare full independently expected state and traces.
Rule ordering is qualified lock/exact credit, D-F/D-S, D-L, D-M, then D-G, then original missing-pin warning. Earlier branches continue and cannot append lower-priority frontier evidence.

D-G uses default SKIPPED/INFO, literal approved message/hint/target notes, existing first declaration/import evidence and sorted distinct target paths. No applicability, empty-result Python veto, schema, engine, renderer or redaction changes are introduced.

Read-only cross-review of consumer tests found literal complete finding/report expectations for credit, precedence, coverage independence, suppression, thresholds, text/export and determinism consistent with the approved contract.

The consumer shallow-include CLI test proves fresh-scan restoration, not temporal deep-first ordering; independent core cases explicitly verify both actual root orders and per-root captured-node snapshots. Historical 22 cases remain unchanged.

approved_patch_verification.method_note: Direct unified-diff byte comparison was not used as the oracle: Git includes function context and chooses different equivalent blank-line hunk alignment. Each approved old hunk was matched literally against HEAD, then its new text was applied in memory and the complete result compared with the working specification.

focused_validation.affected_skip_reason: All 19 related scanner skips are existing symlinks unavailable: OSError cases caused by symlink permission limits in this ordinary-account Windows context. They are not passed tests or security PASS. Parent-owned administrator security preflight and final full gate remain separate and are still pending at this review.

This review and focused verification do not claim final quality, five-project validation, CI or resource acceptance. Parent-owned gates remain separate.
